company.name: MYCRANE
company.shortDescription: MYCRANE is a digital marketplace for crane rental and heavy lifting equipment procurement.
company.description: MYCRANE is a B2B digital platform that operates an online marketplace for crane rental, heavy lifting equipment sourcing, and related industrial services. Its platform connects contractors, project owners, procurement teams, and crane suppliers to facilitate the rental and trading of cranes and lifting equipment across construction, infrastructure, energy, logistics, and industrial sectors.

productsAndServices.description: A digital crane-rental marketplace where contractors submit lift requirements, receive quotes from verified crane suppliers, compare specifications and pricing, and confirm equipment rentals online.
productsAndServices.name: MYCRANE Crane Rental Platform

productsAndServices.description: An online bidding service for crane rentals that lets shortlisted, verified suppliers compete on submitted project requirements to help customers compare and secure rental offers.
productsAndServices.name: MYCRANE Reverse Auction

productsAndServices.description: A digital marketplace for buying and selling new or used cranes and other heavy equipment, connecting equipment buyers and sellers through online listings.
productsAndServices.name: MYCRANE Marketplace and Trading

productsAndServices.description: A free crane-selection tool that matches project requirements such as load weight, lifting height, and radius with suitable crawler and mobile crane capacities.
productsAndServices.name: MYCRANE Crane Selector

productsAndServices.description: Project support for crane selection, lift planning, method statements, logistics, and related documentation needed to prepare and execute heavy-lifting operations.
productsAndServices.name: MYCRANE Engineering and Logistics Support

productsAndServices.description: A supplier-facing service for crane rental companies to register, upload fleet and documents, define service areas, view matched inquiries, submit quotes, and manage proposals online.
productsAndServices.name: MYCRANE Supplier Fleet Listing and Bid Management
